items.title: 3 Cash-Producing Stocks We Approach with Caution
items.summary: While strong cash flow is a key indicator of stability, it doesn’t always translate to superior returns. Some cash-heavy businesses struggle with inefficient spending, slowing demand, or weak competitive positioning.

items.title: Is Disney Stock A Bargain Or Just A Slower Grower?
items.summary: Walt Disney (DIS) has lost about 7% over the past twelve months while the S&P 500 gained 17%. Disney trades at 21.3 times earnings, just under an S&P 500 median of 22.5. The question is whether that is a good business on sale, or a fair price for a slow grower.

items.summary: Shares of cable news and media network Fox (NASDAQ:FOXA) jumped 3.7% in the afternoon session after Citizens JMP initiated coverage on the company with a Market Outperform rating and a $95 price target. According to Streetinsider, Citizens analyst Matthew Condon highlighted that Fox's strategic emphasis on live sports and news helps insulate the business from the fierce competition seen in scripted-content streaming.
